cap: The pudendal nerve (S2 to S4) leaves the pelvis below the piriformis, hooks around the ischial spine, where a pudendal block is placed, and runs in the pudendal canal to give inferior rectal, perineal and dorsal branches. Erection is parasympathetic, emission sympathetic and ejaculation somatic: point, squeeze, shoot. Sympathetic damage leaves the internal sphincter open, so semen flows back into the bladder.
